cues: The oxide is reduced with coke in fireclay retorts at about sixteen seventy kelvin.
At that temperature zinc, which boils at nine hundred and seven degrees, comes off as a vapour.
It is led into condensers and collects as liquid zinc.
This is why zinc was isolated so late in history: cool the vapour in air, and it simply burns back to oxide.
